# Executive Pre-Meeting Briefing: Databricks

## Overview
- **Target Company:** Databricks
- **Meeting Date:** 2026-11-20T10:00:00+05:30
- **Current Date Context:** 2026-11-15
- **Objective:** Provide a comprehensive, one-page equivalent pre-meeting briefing focusing on corporate developments over the trailing 30 days (mid-October to mid-November 2026), strategic trajectories, critical talking points, and open exploratory questions.

---

## Recent Developments

Databricks has experienced a period of immense momentum and scaling, highlighted by robust financial performance and aggressive global expansion. The company surpassed a $7 billion revenue run-rate, achieving over 80% year-over-year (YoY) growth ([Databricks, 2026](https://www.databricks.com/company/newsroom/press-releases/databricks-grows-80-yoy-surpasses-7b-revenue-run-rate-scales)). More than 20,000 organizations worldwide—including 70% of the Fortune 500 such as adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, and Unilever—rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform ([Databricks, 2026](https://www.databricks.com/company/newsroom/press-releases/databricks-grows-80-yoy-surpasses-7b-revenue-run-rate-scales)). 

In terms of regional growth and infrastructure investment, Databricks announced a substantial capital commitment in November 2026, pledging to invest approximately $3 billion across Europe and the Middle East to accelerate enterprise AI adoption ([Databricks, 2026](https://www.databricks.com/company/newsroom/press-releases/databricks-launches-new-always-genie-autonomous-ai-complex)). This follows a localized announcement on November 10, 2026, committing over $500 million specifically in the Netherlands to bolster enterprise data and AI infrastructure ([Databricks, 2026](https://www.databricks.com/company/newsroom/press-releases/databricks-launches-new-always-genie-autonomous-ai-complex)). 

Product innovation has centered heavily on autonomous intelligence and enterprise workflows. On November 11, 2026, Databricks launched the second generation of Genie—introducing the "always-on" autonomous AI agent designed for complex enterprise work ([Databricks, 2026](https://www.databricks.com/company/newsroom/press-releases/databricks-launches-new-always-genie-autonomous-ai-complex)). This system enables employees to assign goals to Genie, which then takes ownership, delegates to subagents, tracks progress, follows up on missing inputs, and interacts via a dedicated inbox or email alerts when human decisions are required ([Databricks, 2026](https://www.databricks.com/company/newsroom/press-releases/databricks-launches-new-always-genie-autonomous-ai-complex)). Alongside this release, Ontology Manager was introduced as a centralized tool to manage and govern business context, allowing teams to refine governed definitions for Genie ([Databricks, 2026](https://www.databricks.com/company/newsroom/press-releases/databricks-launches-new-always-genie-autonomous-ai-complex)).

Furthermore, technical documentation updates on Azure Databricks in October 2026 expanded code-first agent development capabilities, detailing the Agent Bricks compute stack, DurableAgentServer for persistent run state and crash recovery, and Agent Runtime running on Databricks Apps ([Microsoft, 2026](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/databricks/release-notes/product/2026/october)). Strategic enterprise adoption is also scaling, underscored by Fox Corporation selecting Databricks as its strategic partner for next-generation data and AI platforms in mid-October 2026 ([Databricks, 2026](https://www.databricks.com/company/newsroom/press-releases/databricks-launches-new-always-genie-autonomous-ai-complex)).
